Senate predecessor to HF976 omnibus tax revisions, including data center incentive provisions.

Created the Business Incentives for Growth (BIG) program. The eligibility rules in the new Code section 15.504 require the business to be "primarily engaged in advanced manufacturing, bioscience, insurance and finance, or technology and innovation" and explicitly exclude data center businesses, retail businesses, and certain restricted-membership businesses ("The business shall not be a data center business, a retail business, or a business where a cover charge or membership requirement restricts certain individuals from entering the business"). Data center business is defined by reference to Iowa Code 423.3(95).
